description.text: The first expansion of the Pokémon Card Game DPt series, released on 10 October 2008 to match the Nintendo DS game Pokémon Platinum. The Pt in DPt is platinum's chemical symbol, and the t stands for Trainer: the series introduced SP Pokémon, Pokémon caught or raised by a particular Trainer. Here they belong to Team Galactic and carry a G mark, like Skuntank G and Toxicroak G, with Dialga G and Palkia G as LV.X, while Giratina and Shaymin change Forme. The cards are numbered to 96, ending with Scyther, Electabuzz and Hitmonchan in Ken Sugimori's artwork from the first sets. In English the set became Platinum in February 2009.
